name: Standardising what already exists
desc: Most organisations start from Selenium nobody has run, a `.feature` file whose steps drifted, and a Postman collection with the real expectations in `pm.test` scripts.
The SDET Architect inventories all of it and emits one architecture and one `MIGRATION.md`.
Every line a human still has to think about carries a `TODO(sdet-architect)` comment with its source `file:line`.
